svg.text: All other boards: single-color green LED only (blink / on / off)
R → G → B → white flash, then 3× white blinks
always plays, ignores LED on/off setting
Fade in 400 ms → peak → fade out 400 ms
every 30 s, non-blocking, off between pulses
Steady = held on until state changes
Timed = on for N ms then automatically off
Faded = brightness interpolated each loop tick (non-blocking)
